Clickable div acting as a button

This one is a real button, reachable by keyboard and announced as a button.

These two are not

No role, no tabindex, no keydown or keyup handler. Neither is focusable, neither appears in the tab order, both are announced as plain text, and neither responds to Enter or Space. They are styled to be indistinguishable from the real button, so the failure is invisible unless you put the mouse down.

No axe rule fires on either of them. This class is the archetypal AI-codegen failure and it needs a behavioural check in a real browser.
